breakdown.description: The prompt uses the polar moment J in the Euler buckling formula, even though Euler buckling depends on the flexural second moment I.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the area moment of inertia I = π d⁴ / 64 in the Euler buckling formula, not the polar moment J = π d⁴ / 32 as incorrectly stated in the incomplete prompt. This matches the ground truth.

breakdown.description: The prompt multiplies the critical load by the factor of safety to obtain the allowable load, whereas the allowable load should be the critical load divided by the factor of safety.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly defines the allowable load as P_allow = P_cr / n (dividing by the factor of safety), not P_allow = n × P_cr (multiplying) as incorrectly stated in the incomplete prompt. This matches the ground truth.
